reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-02 freezes mass/thrust targets, 56x20/45KV/18S propulsion class, 18S bus architecture and DC-side ESC capability. PASS means controlled value closure/traceability, not physical verification.

backlog.note: Conservative metric: only tasks explicitly marked DONE are counted. UAV-002 is now DONE because PB-02 numerically closes rotor count, hover thrust, max-thrust capability and thrust margin.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 remain OPEN because flight time/energy/environment, detailed mass allocation, bus minimum/sag, phase current, PWM, protection and thermal requirements remain unresolved. G2-G7 remain dependency-blocked.
